methods.name: conversation.active.list
methods.description: Enumerate a complete immutable snapshot, default limit 20, maximum 100. Cursor binds route/current generation and, for unread, readerScope. Invalid bindings return invalid_cursor; expired snapshots return conversation_cursor_expired. Unsupported must be an error, never an empty result.

methods.name: conversation.unread.list
methods.description: Enumerate a complete immutable snapshot, default limit 20, maximum 100. Cursor binds route/current generation and, for unread, readerScope. Invalid bindings return invalid_cursor; expired snapshots return conversation_cursor_expired. Unsupported must be an error, never an empty result.

methods.name: conversation.markRead
methods.description: Advance this reader only up to the observed activity version, monotonically and durably. A newer activity remains unread. Preserve baseline/read progress; reject an invalid or future version as invalid_activity_version.

methods.name: conversation.list
methods.description: Without query/readerScope, preserve existing projectFilter/cursor/limit behavior. query requires its conversationListQuery capability; readerScope additionally requires conversation.unread.list capability and an authoritative read store. updatedAfter intersects projectFilter; ids requires projectFilter.kind=all. With readerScope, return authoritative Conversation.readState for every summary. Cursors bind route, query, projectFilter and readerScope; changing any is invalid_cursor.

events.name: event.conversationActiveChanged
events.description: Ordered active-set invalidation and current fact, including active=false on exit. revision identifies this invalidation, not any active enumeration snapshot. Events must cover externally observed execution too. Host tracks a local event fence during snapshot construction.

events.name: event.conversationUnreadChanged
events.description: Ordered reader-scoped unread fact/invalidation, including unread=false after markRead. revision identifies this invalidation, not any unread enumeration snapshot. Host must not forward scope or read state to other readers; every activity or markRead event invalidates the affected reader view.

events.name: event.conversationDeleted
events.description: Ordered authoritative deletion invalidation. Missing requested IDs are not evidence of deletion unless the Provider established absence. Invalidate affected list/active/unread snapshots.

events.name: event.conversationUpserted
events.description: 会话新增或更新事件的载荷；由 Provider 向 Host 发布，事件名和交付规则见 events.json。

events.name: event.conversationItemUpserted
events.description: Canonical item update, or a content invalidation with conversation and no item. Receivers fetch the latest page only when they do not hold interaction control. At least one of item or conversation is required; when both exist their conversation routes must agree.
